entry_points.summary: Read-only Sonnet single-dimension auditor; writes findings file, returns counts.
/z-plan-split leaf planner; writes cluster SPEC/PLAN/TASKS, escalates risky decisions.
Haiku task classifier returning low|medium|high for model routing.
Primary provider proxy; supports 11 modes including generate-hypotheses rounds.
Secondary provider proxy; same mode surface as primary, distinct provider role.
Read-only Haiku fetcher over INDEX/concept JSON/MEMORIES-FLAT.md; returns synthesis.
Refreshes one concept doc pair; preserves memories[] verbatim; dry-run default.
Haiku web/API retrieval worker; emits lookup-contract envelope; verb-blocklist enforced.
Implements exactly one task block; mandatory self-check before returning STATUS: ok.
Sonnet branch-diff quality reviewer; dedup+consensus+dismissal merge; fenced JSON return.
Haiku advisory router for ambiguous plan-family decisions; parseable route contract.
Haiku mechanical remote verifier: sandbox builds, paper checks, logs, read-only DB.
Provider proxy for task correctness/spec review; blockers+majors only return.
Haiku post-run memory candidate generator; proposes 0-3 candidates as fenced JSON.
Haiku preflight verifier for SPEC references before implementation.

invariants: Each agent is spawned fresh per invocation; callers pass all required context.
Commands/skills own orchestration, user interaction, artifact writes, and final routing decisions.
consultant-primary, consultant-secondary, and reviewer resolve providers via scripts/resolve-provider.sh.
Proxy agents emit consult_start before provider calls so liveness checks can detect hangs.
doc-updater must preserve existing memories[] verbatim and never author memories.
external-lookup must follow docs/llm/lookup-contract.json and refuse mutating commands.
planning-router is read-only and advisory; malformed or unsafe routing returns ask_user/bad_input.
mr-reviewer reviews quality, not correctness, and returns JSON for the orchestrator to write.
remote-runner executes mechanical checks only; interpretive debugging returns to the caller.
cluster-planner refuses nested plan-split outputs when an ancestor MANIFEST.md exists.
review-agent never writes; orchestrator owns all writes via /z-suggest-memory.
review-agent returns exactly one fenced JSON block; any other form is treated as malformed.
gotchas: codex-consultant.md, gemini-consultant.md, and codex-reviewer.md are stale names.
check-timeout.sh is sourced by proxy agents; missing timeout/gtimeout leaves TIMEOUT_CMD empty.
planning-router must not infer missing quantitative signals from filesystem exploration.
doc-updater dry-run returns proposed docs; /z-maintain-docs decides whether to write them.
external-lookup's canonical contract is lookup-contract.json, not only inline agent prose.
remote-runner refuses DB writes, real-money operations, destructive ops, and interpretive work.
mr-reviewer never writes MR-REVIEW.md; callers parse its fenced JSON response.
spec-precheck validates factual SPEC references, not design quality or runtime semantics.
doc-fetcher Ripgrep is a soft dependency; falls back to Python word-boundary scan if rg is missing.
review-agent caps candidates at 3 and emits [] rather than padding; slug anti-patterns are banned.
